rejected_claims.why_rejected: The second real call site contains it too. llm/interpret.py:319 sits inside _attempt(), and interpret() wraps _attempt() in try/except Exception at llm/interpret.py:233-267, so forcing the input into the real path returns rather than raises (accepted=False, status=unavailable, card prints the pending sentence). parse_fields() returns an exact builtin dict, so no CLI or Slack input can deliver a subclass. rejected_claims.claim: Homoglyph drug names are neither normalized nor distinguished.
rejected_claims.why_rejected: The fixture is mis-specified and the 'not distinguished' half fails. In toрсеtrаpib the substitute at position 2 is U+0440 CYRILLIC SMALL LETTER ER, whose closest Latin shape is 'p' (0.0% mismatch against p, 57.3% against the r it replaced), so a reader sees topcetrapib. With a corrected fixture using only genuine homoglyphs, the rendered lane labels still differ: 386 differing pixels, 26.5% ink moved.
